objects.name: Aster Protocol
objects.type: atmospheric stabilisation method and field prototype
objects.function: Reduces a cascading atmospheric feedback loop when activated through Final Thaw Station.
limits: Does not restore the previous climate instantly.
Does not solve political distribution by itself.
Requires intact enough prototype and functional relay systems.
objects.writing_rule: Never describe it as magic or a universal cure.

objects.name: Helix Evidence Archive
objects.type: records of sabotage and suppressed Aster test results
objects.function: Creates final preserve/erase choice and determines whether public accountability is possible.
objects.writing_rule: Evidence has a cost in time and exposure, but must never make game completion impossible.

objects.name: Final Thaw Station
objects.function: Only operational relay capable of scaling Aster deployment.
objects.writing_rule: A physical place with maintenance history, workers, systems, and vulnerabilities; not a generic sci-fi superweapon.
